sentences.text: The holotype specimen PVL 3827 consists of a complete skull, mandibles, and a nearly complete postcranial skeleton.
Three other specimens are known, including one that is almost as complete as the holotype.
The holotype specimen PVL 3827 was found in the Los Colorados Formation in northwestern Argentina.
Its family, Ornithosuchidae, consisted of facultatively bipedal pseudosuchians with adaptations for scavenging.
A 2026 study of the snout's neurovascular anatomy suggests a sensory system similar to extant crocodilians and birds, supporting wading-foraging behavior.
The time range is recorded as Norian to Norian (227.3 to 205.7 million years ago).
